license_and_commercial_rights: Apache-2.0 (repository LICENSE); commercial use permitted with attribution and license notice retained
schema_and_format: GTFS-Flex feed (zipped GTFS text files with Flex extensions: stop_times with pickup/drop-off booking rules, location groups, booking_rules.txt) -- the standard for demand-responsive transport, the closest public standard to how paratransit trips are actually requested
canonical_contract: themis.canonical.entities.ServiceRequest (GTFS-Flex booking rules -> ServiceRequest is a future Connect adapter, MX-B-GTFS-FLEX-ADAPTER)

quality_tests.name: valid_zip
quality_tests.description: retained object is a non-empty zip archive

acceptance_threshold: downloads, non-empty, is a readable zip containing GTFS text files
retention_and_deletion: retain as part of the standards-adapter certification corpus; cheaply reproducible (re-fetchable from upstream) so evictable first
